description: This PHP source file defines the 'Mail' class within the OpenCart system, providing an interface for email operations such as setting recipients, sender info, subject, body, attachments, and sending emails. It dynamically loads a specific mail adaptor class based on the configuration.

classes.name: Mail
classes.description: Provides an abstraction for sending emails using different adaptors. It facilitates setting email parameters and dispatching emails through dynamically loaded adaptor classes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Mail object by dynamically loading and instantiating the specified mail adaptor class.

methods.name: setTo
methods.description: Sets the recipient(s) of the email.

methods.name: setSender
methods.description: Sets the sender's name or address.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the plain text body of the email.

methods.name: setHtml
methods.description: Sets the HTML body of the email.

methods.name: addAttachment
methods.description: Adds a filename to the list of attachments for the email.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends the email using the configured adaptor.
